rationale.edition: The changed file paths span both trees. The bulk live under open-source locations (src/** backend — Splunk HEC collector routes, org ingestion-token storage/migration — and web/src/** frontend). One path, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/super_cluster/queue/mod.rs, is an enterprise-owned location (super-cluster queue redaction of the new org-ingestion-token key). Because the diff combines an OSS feature with an enterprise layer, edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: No skip marker is present: trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty and no 'tests-added' label was passed. The change is user-facing (a new Splunk HEC ingestion page plus Splunk token management in the Ingestion Tokens UI), so the skip gate does not apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. A new Splunk HEC tab/page was added to the Logs ingestion section (SplunkHec.vue plus a new 'splunkhec' route), and the Ingestion Tokens UI gained a Splunk token column, a generate/revoke action, a create-with-Splunk-token checkbox, and a reveal dialog showing the Splunk token and HEC URL. These are all user-exercisable UI flows.
rationale.area: GeneralTests — the feature is ingestion configuration (a new log-ingestion method plus org ingestion-token management), and the existing ingestion-config.spec.js already lives in GeneralTests. The changed Vue files sit under web/src/components/ingestion/logs/ and web/src/components/iam/; no dedicated 'Ingestion' test folder exists in the matrix.
rationale.group: GeneralTests — this matrix shard already carries ingestion-config.spec.js, the closest existing spec to this ingestion-configuration feature; the new spec should join that shard's run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit specs under web/src/** (e.g. SplunkHec.spec.ts, IngestionTokens.spec.ts) and Rust tests; none are under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so there is no existing E2E coverage to enhance.
